subject: Hosted API commit: proposal for laddered commit + burst cushion
summary: Customer requests higher monthly commit and relief on rate caps for seasonal spikes. Internal discussion resulted in a laddered commit proposal with a small burst cushion and guardrails; client approved and requested DocuSign.
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@streamlineai.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal discussion — increasing hosted commit + burst behavior

Soojin,

Quick note — our usage has jumped more than we forecasted for Q4 due to a new personalization rollout. We are approaching our current monthly token commit and seeing throttles on peak days. We'd like to discuss a renewal amendment to increase the monthly hosted commit and loosen the hard rate cap during scheduled campaign windows.

Current ask: +2.5x monthly commit for Nov-Feb, ability to burst 30% above commit for 48 hours (with a negotiated overage rate), and a smoother rate limit so our frontend doesn't surface 429s to end users.

Can you share what a short-term uplift and pricing looks like? We can do a 12-month extension if the economics and SLAs align.

Cheers,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Integrations
StreamlineAI

Attachments: 202609-usage-summary.csv (CSV), internal-dashboard-screenshot.png (image)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@streamlineai.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 13:10:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — increasing hosted commit + burst behavior

Alex — thanks for the context and the usage file, that helps. Looping in Jordan (AE) and Vanessa (CS) to coordinate the commercial and operational parts.

High-level response: we can structure a laddered commit that grows with your seasonal window and include a limited burst cushion for short spikes. A couple quick clarifying q's:
- Do you need the burst to be automatically allowed or gated behind an API-level fallback to a smaller model?
- Is the 2.5x target an estimate for peak months (Nov–Feb) or a new baseline?

Jordan/Vanessa — I'll leave pricing and SLO notes to you; if we can propose a short-term amendment (4-month elevated commit within a 12-month term) + a burst buffer with a capped overage rate, that should meet their requirement without committing to a permanent tier change.

— Soojin
SoojIn Lee

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:02:45 -0400
Subject: Internal: draft pricing for StreamlineAI uplift

Team — rough sketch for discussion before we send to StreamlineAI: 

Proposal elements:
- Term: 12 months starting 2026-11-01.
- Commit ladder: Base monthly commit = current baseline (kept as-is). Elevated tranche for Nov–Feb = +2.0x month-over-month (we can offer 2.5x but margin gets thin). Ladder steps: Nov/Dec = +2.5x, Jan = +2.0x, Feb = +1.5x, then revert to baseline.
- Burst cushion: 30% automatic burst for up to 48 hours per calendar month with metering; overage when exceeded charged at 1.8x list rate.
- Rate shaping: set soft rate limit to reduce head-of-line 429s (adaptive leaky-bucket) and hard limit only at extreme overload.
- Pricing: incremental effective blended rate: 0.95x of current list per extra committed unit for the elevated months (volume discount), with a capped aggregate overage cap of $50k per month during burst months.
- Incentive: 5% credit on overage if they sign amendment before 2026-10-10.

Operational notes: Ops will need to configure per-customer routing policy (region us-west) and temporary model fallback plan (if burst beyond cushion, route to quantized variant). Vanessa — can you confirm SRE/CS readiness for the adaptive rate shaping?

— Karthik
VP, Sales Strategy

Quoted previous: "High-level response: we can structure a laddered commit..."

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@streamlineai.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:37:22 -0400
Subject: Proposal: 4-month elevated commit + 30% burst cushion — StreamlineAI (DL-2026-0743)

Alex — thanks again for the usage sheet and for walking me through the campaign cadence. Below is our formal proposal (summarized):

What we propose
- Term & timing: 12-month amendment (2026-11-01 — 2027-10-31) with a 4-month elevated commit window for Nov–Feb.
- Commit ladder (elevated months): Nov = 2.5x baseline, Dec = 2.5x baseline, Jan = 2.0x baseline, Feb = 1.5x baseline.
- Burst cushion: 30% automatic burst available for up to 48 hours per calendar month. Any sustained usage beyond cushion triggers overage at 1.8x list rate; automatic notifications and a 2-hour warm-up pre-burst option available.
- Rate shaping & fallback: implement an adaptive soft limit to reduce 429s and configure automatic fallback to a quantized-variant model when system load exceeds the hard limit.
- Pricing & protections: elevated-commit units billed at 0.95x current list; overage cap during elevated months = $50,000/month. 5% early-signing credit if signed by 2026-10-10.

Attachments: StreamlineAI_MAAP_SOW_v2.pdf (proposed SOW and amendment), 202609-usage-summary.csv (their usage).

Next steps
1) If this structure looks good, we will issue an amendment and DocuSign envelope (Jordan will send).
2) Ops will schedule a short runbook walkthrough with StreamlineAI and enable the adaptive rate shaping on a test path prior to Nov 1.

Please let me know if you want different ladder math (we can make Nov/Dec equal or trim Jan). We prioritized keeping margin healthy while giving them breathing room for the campaign.

Best,
SoojIn Lee
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0123

SoojIn / team — this looks solid and addresses our immediate concerns. Two quick asks before we sign: 
1) Can you add a clause allowing one pre-scheduled campaign to request a temporary burst window of 72 hours (instead of 48) once during the elevated period with a mutually agreed 2x overage rate?
2) Please include an SLA note about end-to-end 95th percentile tail latency during burst events (we need an operational commitment so our product team can be comfortable).

If you can add those, we are prepared to sign the amendment next week. Jordan, please send the DocuSign when ready.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform Integrations
StreamlineAI
